description: This is a set of unit tests for the DatabaseUpdater class within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing database update functions and changelog execution.

classes.name: DatabaseUpdaterTest
classes.description: Test class for DatabaseUpdater, verifying database update methods, changelog execution, and proper provider handling.

methods.name: updatesRequired_shouldAlwaysHaveAValidUpdateToLatestFile
methods.description: Verifies that the updatesRequired method does not throw exceptions when the changelog is valid.

methods.name: shouldRejectNullAsChangelog
methods.description: Checks that passing null as changelog throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: shouldRejectNullAsChangelogFilenames
methods.description: Checks that passing null filename array throws RuntimeException caused by IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: shouldRejectEmptyArrayAsChangelogFilenames
methods.description: Checks that passing an empty filename array throws RuntimeException caused by IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: shouldReturnInjectedLiquibaseProvider
methods.description: Verifies that setting and getting LiquibaseProvider works as expected.

methods.name: shouldExecuteLiquibaseFileRelativeToApplicationDataDirectory
methods.description: Ensures that executing a changelog file relative to the application data directory functions correctly.
